name: frasalvi-project-oversight
description: Marketplace for my custom set of plugins for Claude Code

plugins.name: team-development
plugins.description: Plan execution with persistent worker teammates per code domain: workers ask instead of guessing, runs and experiments stay with the lead and the user, and one Opus whole-branch review gates paid runs and the merge. Companion to superpowers.

plugins.name: research-companion
plugins.description: Strategic research thinking agents — idea evaluation, project triage, and structured brainstorming inspired by Carlini's research methodology

plugins.name: project-oversight
plugins.description: Roadmap oversight: cut a project into steps that each deliver one thing, weighted Full, Light or Paired by how they will be worked, scope later steps lazily, and revise the roadmap as work lands.

plugins.name: pr-review-triage
plugins.description: Triage PR review comments inline: verify each bot claim against the code and how the project actually runs, fix what's real, dismiss the rest with evidence, then merge and clean up.

plugins.name: overleaf-editor
plugins.description: Edit an Overleaf-synced LaTeX document as a scientific editor: pull first, handle AI TODOs, push new drafts, propose edits to existing prose as diffs, and keep the writing free of AI tells.
